Parent #1926 / #1645. Prerequisites: Agent complete/checkpoint-required/unavailable replay; Relay Agent stream positions; degraded gap detection.

## Requirements: Terminal P3 — Relay resume through authenticated Agent tunnel

Relay must be able to ask the **same Agent stream owner** for replay using the existing `agent.terminal.stream.resume` contract, not infer continuity from Server sequence or tmux text capture.

### Scope
- Browser Relay capability exposes `resumeRelayStream(sessionName, epoch, afterSeq)` using the active authenticated Server→Agent relay tunnel; no new Server sequence source.
- Share exactly the same `readResumeReply` implementation as P2P (including `complete`, `checkpoint-required`, `unavailable` and no partial replay on contradiction), rather than a divergent Relay decoder.
- ConnectionManager must feed validated Relay live output/authoritative resize to its existing ordered StreamReconciler. Gap recovery uses Relay API only while that exact route/connection is live. Unpositioned legacy output/level resize cannot seed a synchronized cursor.
- Relay fallback when API unavailable/old provider/epoch mismatch must explicitly degrade and request bootstrap, not silently leap to the latest frame or report synchronized.
- Generation fence reattach/dispose; tests cover relay output→resize→output, gap response success, incomplete/expiry, epoch change, legacy and stale reply, no invented parser ACK.
- Remains **partial P3** until route handoff, renderer-applied baseline, Relay ACK and real TUI/high-volume multi-client E2E proven.

### Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01 Relay asks Agent for complete-only stream replay with same recovery semantics and authenticated route.
- [ ] SC-02 Relay output and authoritative resize enter one ordered reconciler; missing/stale/incomplete events cannot be silently promoted to synced.
- [x] SC-03 Old route/epoch callbacks and rejection do not advance current renderer; legacy fallback remains degraded.
- [ ] SC-04 Exact PR HEAD Quality / E2E (Issue-selected lane) / Case Smoke / trusted Acceptance, and exact merge-SHA Quality / Full E2E / Cases / Orchestrator Pass.

## Acceptance Plan
```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-03:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-04:
    when: merged
    branch: main
    method: agent
```

## Acceptance Report

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| SC-01 | Pass | run 39398876921; ref d5603709eecfff6f4591cc67733713bddb01e745; source agent-cursor; file: web/src/product/terminal/server.ts: resumeRelayStream uses TERMINAL_STREAM_RESUME_WIRE via requireConnection().request and readResumeReply(reply, epoch); file: web/src/product/terminal/agent.ts:376-404 readResumeReply enforces complete/checkpoint-required/unavailable and drops events unless safeToApply (provenComplete or legacy undefined fields); file: web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/ConnectionManager.ts:623-629 relay mode calls serverConnection.resumeRelayStream on the authenticated Server tunnel; summary: Relay resume uses the same agent.terminal.stream.resume contract and shared readResumeReply complete-only decoder over the authenticated Server→Agent relay request path. |
| SC-02 | Fail | run 39398876921; ref d5603709eecfff6f4591cc67733713bddb01e745; source agent-cursor; file: web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/ConnectionManager.ts:683-698 setupRelay forwards relay onRelayOutput/onRelayResize directly to onOutput/onResize with comment that relay positions are NOT admitted to the ordered timeline; file: web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/ConnectionManager.ts:490-516 P2P setupP2P feeds live frames through reconciler.acceptLive/acceptLiveResize, but relay setupRelay never calls reconciler for live output or authoritative resize; summary: Live relay output and positioned resize bypass StreamReconciler and go display-only, so they do not enter the single ordered reconciler as SC-02 requires. |
| SC-03 | Pass | run 39398876921; ref d5603709eecfff6f4591cc67733713bddb01e745; source agent-cursor; file: web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/streamReconciler.ts:421-442 onReply ignores replies when flight.generation !== this.generation or epochMatch is false (reset without applying stale events); file: web/src/product/terminal/agent.ts:376-404 readResumeReply rejects contradictory complete claims and returns empty events when recovery is unavailable or not proven complete; file: web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/ConnectionManager.ts:638-676 observeRelayPosition treats legacy/unpositioned relay output as degraded (onStreamTruncated) rather than advancing an observed frontier silently; file: web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/AppliedTerminalCursor.ts:92-98 recordParsed returns stale/invalid for wrong binding or stream epoch so old callbacks cannot advance the current renderer cursor; summary: Stale route/epoch resume replies and generation-mismatched callbacks are discarded or flagged truncated, and legacy relay output stays degraded instead of promoting a synchronized cursor. |
| SC-04 | Fail | run 39401547053; ref 21f88cc51da96c7d635baff71f3fb8279c74135d; source agent-cursor; workflow: PR #2051 head d5603709 E2E / Tests run 39398881358 success with job step Enforce authenticated selected-E2E execution result (selected, not full gate); workflow: PR #2051 head d5603709 Acceptance / Orchestrator run 39398876921 completed conclusion failure; workflow: main merge SHA 21f88cc51da96c7d635baff71f3fb8279c74135d E2E / Tests run 39400308266 full gate mode all Pass (merge-only full regression); workflow: PR #2051 head d5603709 CI / Quality Gate 39398881266 and Acceptance / Case Smoke 39398881233 completed success; summary: PR-head Case Smoke and Quality pass, but exact PR E2E is authenticated selected execution not Full E2E, and PR Acceptance / Orchestrator failed, so trusted Acceptance and exact PR-head Full E2E are not met despite merge-SHA full E2E. |
